title: Technical Proposal / Customer Proposal / RFP Response
purpose: Respond to a defined customer need or solicitation with a compliant, technically credible and commercially clear offer.

sections.title: Solicitation Compliance Matrix
sections.instruction: Map every RFP/call requirement to response section, evidence, owner and compliance status. Flag exceptions.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.instruction: Customer need, proposed solution, outcomes, differentiators, price range if authorized and key assumptions.

sections.title: Understanding of Need
sections.instruction: Restate operational context, users, constraints, success criteria and risks for customer confirmation.

sections.title: Proposed Solution
sections.instruction: Architecture, scope, functions, components, interfaces, deployment and options.

sections.title: Requirements Compliance
sections.instruction: Requirement-by-requirement response: compliant, partial, deviation, not applicable, clarification required.

sections.title: Delivery and Implementation Plan
sections.instruction: Work packages, schedule, responsibilities, dependencies, acceptance gates, transition and training.

sections.title: Verification: Validation and Acceptance
sections.instruction: Test levels, acceptance criteria, evidence, customer witness points, defect handling and handover.

sections.title: Operations: Support and Service
sections.instruction: Availability, maintenance, response times, spares, upgrades, cybersecurity and end-of-life.

sections.title: Safety: Security: Privacy and Compliance
sections.instruction: Applicable requirements, data handling, access, hazards, regulatory profile and responsibility split.

sections.title: Team and Governance
sections.instruction: Named roles only where confirmed; escalation, customer interfaces and decision rights.

sections.title: Commercial Offer
sections.instruction: Pricing structure, assumptions, taxes, exclusions, validity, payment milestones, warranties and change control.

sections.title: Risks: Assumptions and Dependencies
sections.instruction: Customer dependencies, access, data, facilities, approvals, third parties and mitigations.

sections.title: Appendices
sections.instruction: CVs, architecture drawings, compliance matrix, schedule, detailed BOM, certificates and terms.
